text.tspan: USB computer control; generates STEP/DIR.
Checks PD voltage before enabling the motor.
Internal clock avoids an external crystal.
15 V request: CFG1=0, CFG2=CFG3=1.
PG is open-drain, active low. PD-only mode:
chip DP/DM shorted; VBUS sense pin unused.
Creates 3.3 V from diode-OR USB/PD power.
Low-current LDO retained for prototype only;
measure input spikes, current and temperature.
Fixed 1/16 steps; 10k enable/sleep defaults.
3.9k/1k REF divider, 0.24 ohm sense resistors:
0.351 A nominal; measure peak phase current.
Clamps ESD on USB D+ and D- at the data port.
VBUS pin references the USB protection diodes.
Isolates VM ADC when logic power is off.
10k OE pull-up defaults off; MCU gates ON.
Bus/21 when ON; wait 0.5 ms then sample.
Detects host 5 V without direct GPIO feed.
10k base feed and 10k 3.3 V collector pull.
DATA_PRESENT LOW means host attached.
PD PORT: motor power, 15 V requested. DATA PORT: USB computer control.
Motor: 14HM11-0404S, bipolar, 0.4 A/phase. Prototype: firmware/bench/rear-fit validation pending.
